abstract: Each floor $\Cl(p{+}k, q{+}k)$ of the tower is canonically $\Mat_{2^k}(\Cl(p,q))$. [[c:tower.commuting-copies]] Every floor shares the ground floor's charge, centre and obstruction taxonomy, so the physical tower is frozen at clock position $6$. [[c:tower.rigidity-clock-frozen]] Vectors realise at most $\min(p,q)$ fermionic mode pairs, the Witt index, which rises by exactly one at each rung. [[c:tower.witt-index-quantum-capacity]] As $r \to 0$ the rescaled gauge map and metric converge to rank-one limits. [[c:singularity.degeneration-exactly]] The gauge-invariant curvature scalar $R_{abcd}R^{abcd} = 48M^2/r^6$ diverges at $r = 0$, so no gauge choice removes the degeneration. [[c:singularity.non-removability-invariant-argument]] The obstruction is of type N only, since $\Cl(1,3) \cong \Mat_2(\HH)$ is central simple and type P imposes no transport. [[c:singularity.type-n-only-type-n]] On the interior region the vacuum field equations hold exactly when the scale tractor of the physical metric is parallel. [[c:interior.covariant-form-vacuum-equations]] The entropy cost of any pinching is exactly a relative entropy, $\rel{\rho}{E(\rho)} \geq 0$. [[c:singularity.deficit-theorem-cost-descent-exactly]] The descent is the parity average onto the even subalgebra. [[c:singularity.descent-parity-average]] For a faithful single-mode state the partner is the commutant, so purity is an output. [[c:singularity.purity-output-partner-commutant]] The curvature selects the boost plane, with rate $\kappa = 1/4M$ at the horizon. [[c:singularity.plane-rate]] Under (P) and (R) each marginal is the Gibbs state at the Hawking temperature $T = 1/8\pi M$. [[c:singularity.rate-discharge-hypothesis-iii]] The algebra alone does not fix that value. [[c:singularity.rate-rigidity-temperature-not-algebra-intrinsic]] At the Hawking temperature the Fermi-Dirac quasi-free state is the only quasi-free state KMS for the boost dynamics. [[c:hawking.i-state]] Under the linear s-wave weight assignment its current modes carry exactly the Bose-Einstein occupancy on the bilateral ladder, with an exponentially small finite-window correction. [[c:hawking.bose-einstein-occupancy-quantified-window-corrections]]
introduction: This document follows one chain, from the algebra that repairs a failure of division, through the centre of a black hole, to the temperature and the radiation. [[t]] After the premises, it opens with a single piece of general algebra and then builds the tower, because the results at the singularity draw on what the tower preserves and what it adds. [[t]] The singularity section locates and classifies the degeneration, and a short section then recasts the vacuum equations in covariant form. [[t]] The material is grouped by subject, so the cost of discarding information is measured before the descent that discards it is built, and the pair that carries each mode is examined on its own before the descent, parity and states are taken up together. [[t]] The last section brings in the horizon, fixes the temperature, and assembles the Hawking state and its bosonic reading. [[t]] Results used but not proved here are cited at the end with their provenance, followed by the prediction the framework registers. [[t]]

conclusion: Every floor of the tower shares the ground floor's charge, centre and obstruction taxonomy, so the tower changes nothing structural. [[c:tower.rigidity-clock-frozen]] What it adds is exactly one vector-realised fermionic mode at each rung. [[c:tower.witt-index-quantum-capacity]] At the centre of the black hole the degeneration is a property of the solution, not of its presentation. [[c:singularity.non-removability-invariant-argument]] It is an obstruction of type N, so the repair is the completion that supplies the missing partner. [[c:singularity.type-n-only-type-n]] Coming back down from the completion costs exactly a relative entropy. [[c:singularity.deficit-theorem-cost-descent-exactly]] The curvature fixes the rate, so that $2\pi$ of rapidity corresponds to $8\pi M$ of Schwarzschild time. [[c:singularity.plane-rate]] Under (P) and (R) every mode's marginal is the Gibbs state at the Hawking temperature, with no condition on the joint state. [[c:singularity.rate-discharge-hypothesis-iii]] The I-state is the unique quasi-free state that is KMS for the boost dynamics at that temperature. [[c:hawking.i-state]] Under the linear s-wave weight assignment its current modes carry exactly the Bose-Einstein occupancy on the bilateral ladder. [[c:hawking.bose-einstein-occupancy-quantified-window-corrections]] Because the quantum structure sits deep inside the hole, the framework registers that post-merger ringdown is the unmodified Kerr quasinormal spectrum, with no echo train. [[c:scrambling.no-echo-prediction-registered]] What we assume is set out in a short list of premises. [[t]] Univalence (P) requires every physical state of the boundary modes to be even under the grading, so odd elements have zero expectation value. [[c:singularity.p-univalence]] Regularity (R) requires each single-mode marginal to be KMS for the Killing flow at the period $2\pi/\kappa$ dictated by smoothness of the Euclidean section. [[c:singularity.r-regularity-fixed-locus]] Joint quasi-freeness (Q) takes the joint state, in the stationary idealisation, to be the quasi-free state with those marginals, and assigns the mode weights $\omega_k = \kappa k$. [[c:singularity.q-joint-quasi-freeness-s-wave]] The bosonic reading of the boundary currents rests on (Q), and without it no joint KMS state is available. [[c:singularity.bosonisation-bridge-s-wave-sector]] The value of the temperature is meaningful only relative to a parametrisation of the flow, which the algebra does not supply. [[c:singularity.rate-rigidity-temperature-not-algebra-intrinsic]]
